about: measure contests of 2016 in Oklahoma, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1

question.title: State Question No. 776 Legislative Referendum No. 367

threshold.rule: majority of all the electors voting on the proposed amendment
threshold.citation: Okla. Const. art. XXIV, sec. 1, or Okla. Const. art. V, sec. 3, or Okla. Const. art. V, sec. 33(C)
threshold.quote: If a majority of all the electors voting on any proposed amendment at such election shall vote in favor thereof, it shall thereby become a part of this Constitution.

also_governs.applies_to: initiated or referred measure (statute or constitutional amendment by initiative)
also_governs.quote: Any measure referred to the people by the initiative or referendum shall take effect and be in force when it shall have been approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon and not otherwise.

also_governs.applies_to: revenue bill referred to the people
also_governs.quote: shall become effective and be in force when it has been approved by a majority of the votes cast on the measure at such election and not otherwise, except as otherwise provided in subsection D of this section.

threshold.matched: the source's title does not give the type; every rule read for the state's measures (but its convention question) sets this threshold; the source does not show which of these governs it (Okla. Const. art. XXIV, sec. 1: constitutional amendment proposed by Legislature; Okla. Const. art. V, sec. 3: initiated or referred measure (statute or constitutional amendment by initiative); Okla. Const. art. V, sec. 33(C): revenue bill referred to the people), and each sets this share
